name: noNA
title: Does object contain any missing values?

origin.description: Does object contain any missing values?
origin.details: True when no element is missing. The manual samples without a seed, so the last line is one snapshot.
origin.example:
see_if(noNA("a"))
see_if(noNA(c(TRUE, NA)))
x <- sample(c(1:10, NA), 100, rep = TRUE)
see_if(noNA(x))

translation.description: Does object contain any missing values?
translation.details: True when no element is missing. The last line draws once, without a shared seed.
translation.example:
import random

from assertthat import see_if
from assertthat.objects import NA

print(see_if('noNA("a")'))
print(see_if("noNA(c(TRUE, NA))"))
x = random.choices(list(range(1, 11)) + [NA], k=100)
print(see_if("noNA(x)"))
